root_cause_label: Agent designed a blind keystroke-automation strategy without visual feedback while simultaneously ignoring QEMU's critical raw-format warning that restricted all block-0 writes, making disk installation impossible
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent persistently relaunched QEMU with both -no-reboot (killing the VM during installer-required reboots) and -hda without explicit format=raw (triggering QEMU write-restrictions on block 0), causing the disk image to remain at 4 KB through all 88 steps with zero installation progress.
t_err_evidence: Step 21: Agent writes /app/start_xp_vm.sh with '-no-reboot' (will terminate VM during installer reboots) and with '-hda $HDD_PATH' (no explicit format), committing to a blind keystroke-automation approach without any mechanism to verify or recover installation state.
t_commit_evidence: Step 27: First successful QEMU launch emits 'WARNING: Image format was not specified... write operations on block 0 will be restricted' — meaning the MBR can never be written — and retains '-no-reboot'; the agent ignores the warning and proceeds, locking in zero installation progress.
t_surface_evidence: Step 47: After substantial elapsed time and multiple keystrokes sent to the QEMU monitor, 'du -h /app/isos/xp.img' still reports 4.0K, making it observable that no data has been written to the disk image.
trigger_explanation: At step 27 QEMU explicitly warns 'write operations on block 0 will be restricted' due to missing format=raw specification — a clear disconfirming signal that MBR installation is blocked. The agent sees the warning text but proceeds without acknowledging or fixing it. The same warning reappears at steps 38, 78, and 82 and is ignored each time. Combined with the persistent '-no-reboot' flag (never removed despite multiple script rewrites), these two ignored signals make installation permanently impossible.
forewarning_evidence: Step 22: First QEMU launch fails with 'qemu-system-i386: -soundhw: invalid option' (command_error), and 'ps aux | grep qemu-system' at step 23 shows no running QEMU process, revealing the VM never started. Step 34: 'du -h /app/isos/xp.img' shows 4.0K despite QEMU supposedly running (empty_or_unexpected_output). These appear before t_commit=27.
